# UAT purchase cards: answer key

**For us only, not for testers.** Generated by `cd backend && uv run python -m ml.uat.purchase_cards`; do not edit by hand. Testers see the card (provider, item, price, instalments, fee) and the one limit to record, never the band below.

Measured through the same check the browser calls, with the limit applied, on every study day (2026-10-25 to 2026-10-31) and 5 random seeds. The **instructed path** is every Recurring suggestion confirmed. The other path leaves the suggestions alone: the forecast then does not know the standing bills or instalments, and for some cards the answer is different. Bands: Safe below 10%, Caution below 30%, At Risk from 30% (the model's estimate of running short). A range within 2 points of an edge is marked ⚠.

| F2 | Gaming chair | RM 1,300 | 3 | 0% | RM 1,300 / RM 0 | **Caution** 15%-16% | At Risk 68%-69% |
| F3 | Laptop | RM 2,000 | 3 | 0% | RM 1,500 / RM 500 | **At Risk** 86%-87% | At Risk 94%-94% |
